How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Standard shipping timing breaks down into two phases:
Production: Most orders are processed and shipped within 1-5 business days, though more complex items take longer to manufacture. Mattress production typically takes about 3-5 business days, while more complex mattresses can take up to 3 weeks.
Delivery: Once shipped, ground deliveries with USPS or UPS typically take 2-5 business days to arrive. Some sources mention 3-7 business days or 5-7 business days depending on the product.
For larger items that require doorstep/curbside delivery or in-home delivery (items over 150 lbs), these can take 1-3 weeks to arrive at a local delivery hub before the team schedules delivery dates and time windows.
Keep in mind that "business days" don't include weekends or holidays. You'll receive tracking information via email once your order ships, and delivery timelines are estimated by the shippers once the order has been produced at our facilities.

What's your return and refund policy?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Our return policy is designed to give you time to truly experience our products. Here's how it works:
Sleep Trial Period: You must try your mattress or eligible topper for at least 30 days before requesting a return. This adjustment period helps your body adapt to the new sleep surface. After 30 days and within the sleep trial period (100 nights for most mattresses, 1 year for some products), you can request a return. 
Return Fee: We charge $99 per mattress for returns.
Non-Refundable Fees: Shipping fees, In-Home Delivery & Setup service fees, financing fees, and shipping surcharges for Alaska and Hawaii are non-refundable.
Refund Timeline: Once we confirm receipt of your returned items, you'll receive your refund within 1-3 business days, though it can take up to two weeks for your bank to process it back into your account. Refunds are issued via the original payment method only.
Not Eligible for Returns: Final sale items (adjustable bases, clearance/discontinued products, latex mattresses) and promotional "buy-one-get-one-free" items are not eligible for returns.
To start a return, contact us at support@avocadomattress.com to obtain a Return Authorization.
